source.title: Jim Clark — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson
source.locator: See precise paragraph or heading locator on each claim.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 Hall of Fame text inspected on 2026-10-24; primary publisher evidence only, independent corroboration and human review outstanding.

claims.en: Jim Clark won the 1963 and 1965 Drivers' World Championships while racing for Lotus.
claims.uk: Джим Кларк здобув чемпіонські титули Формули-1 у 1963 та 1965 роках, виступаючи за Lotus.

evidence.locator: Hall of Fame heading '1963, 1965'; paragraphs on seven 1963 wins and six 1965 wins with Lotus.
FIA Jim Clark retrospective, 1963 WDC and 1965 WDC entries: both titles for Lotus.

claims.en: His 1965 season also included victory in the Indianapolis 500, a separate event from the Formula 1 World Championship.
claims.uk: У сезоні 1965 року він також переміг в «Індіанаполіс 500» — змаганні, окремому від чемпіонату світу Формули-1.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'The public warmed to the shy champion': 1965 Indianapolis 500 win.
FIA retrospective, 1965 WDC entry: Indianapolis 500 victory and skipped Monaco to compete there.

claims.en: Clark joined Team Lotus during the 1960 Formula 1 season.
claims.uk: Кларк приєднався до Team Lotus протягом сезону Формули-1 1960 року.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'In 1958 Clark was given': promotion to Team Lotus in late 1960.
FIA retrospective, F1 GP debut at Zandvoort in 1960 entry: Lotus debut.

claims.en: Clark won seven championship races in the 1963 season.
claims.uk: У сезоні 1963 року Кларк переміг у семи залікових перегонах.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Over the next four seasons': seven 1963 championship race wins.
FIA retrospective, 1963 WDC entry: seven wins in ten championship races.

claims.en: Clark won six of the ten World Championship races in 1965.
claims.uk: У 1965 році Кларк виграв шість із десяти етапів чемпіонату світу.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'In 1964 he was again deprived': six of ten wins in 1965.
FIA retrospective, 1965 WDC entry: six of ten championship races won.

claims.en: Clark died following an accident in a Formula 2 race at Hockenheim on 7 April 1968.
claims.uk: Кларк загинув після аварії в перегонах Формули-2 на Гоккенгаймринзі 7 квітня 1968 року.

evidence.locator: Final biography paragraph: fatal Formula 2 accident at Hockenheim on 7 April 1968.
FIA retrospective, Death at Hockenheim on 7 April 1968 entry: Formula 2 crash.
